attributions.rationale: "The monthly payment includes both principal and interest.": Payment components coordinate principal with interest, selecting capital amount. Sense:007 is an obligor, not an amount included in a payment.

discriminating_terms: treats a person who knowingly assists the offense as a principal
attributions.rationale: "The statute treats a person who knowingly assists the offense as a principal.": The statutory classification is expressly based on knowing assistance to an offense. Sense:004 requires authority granted to an agent; classification for offense assistance does not express that relation.

"Tourism is a principal source of income for the island.": Principal modifies source attributively and ranks its importance. Sense:003 would itself denote the capital amount rather than qualify source.

"The school principal met with parents after the incident.": The compound names the school's institutional head. Sense:004 names the authorizing party to agency, a relation not expressed by the institutional office compound school principal.

"The borrower will begin repaying principal next year.": Bare mass principal is the amount repaid. Sense:007 is a countable person or entity bearing the debt and cannot supply this bare mass amount object.
"The principal reason for the delay was a shortage of parts.": Principal is an attributive importance modifier of reason. Sense:002 is a person noun and cannot express this reason-ranking relation.

"She is one of the principal architects of the reform.": Principal modifies the plural head architects, indicating importance among architects. Sense:002 would head the person-denoting noun phrase rather than modify architects in this construction.

discriminating_terms: liable as principal for the debt
attributions.rationale: "Under the agreement, the company remains liable as principal for the debt, while the guarantor is only secondarily liable.": Explicit primary-versus-secondary debt liability identifies sense:007. Sense:004 authorizes an agent and does not itself establish this contrast of liability with a guarantor.
"The company moved its principal place of business to Osaka.": Principal ranks a place of business as main. Sense:002 denotes an institutional person, not an attributive ranking of a place.

discriminating_terms: as a principal in the crime
attributions.rationale: "The court identified him as a principal in the crime.": The complement in the crime attaches principal to a person's role in committing an offense. Sense:004 concerns an agent's authorizing party, not classification of the person as participant in the crime.

"The guarantee does not replace the obligation of the principal.": The guarantee and principal's continuing obligation naturally suggest a primary obligor, but no primary/secondary liability contrast or guaranteed debt relation is specified. An agency principal's obligation could also remain despite a guarantee; the same principal use does not exclude sense:004.

"The principal of the college welcomed the new students.": The of-complement forms an institutional head title. Sense:005 requires a performing or sectional orchestral role and does not name the head of a college with this construction.

"The contract created a principal-agent relationship between the owner and the broker.": The relational compound explicitly opposes the principal to its agent. Sense:007 requires primary liability opposite a surety, not the principal-agent authority relation.

"The concert program lists her as one of the orchestra's principals.": The possessive plural role name naturally suggests leading orchestral players, but the sentence supplies no playing, instrument-section, or performer function. Sense:002 organizational leaders also fits the same noun use; appearance in a concert program alone cannot exclude it.

"The agent may sign the document on behalf of the principal.": Principal is the represented party on whose behalf an agent signs. Sense:007 primary debt liability does not express this representation relation.

"The agreement states the duties of the principal and the surety.": Coordination with surety favors primary obligor, but duties are unspecified and coordination alone does not state that the principal bears the secured obligation. An agency principal and a surety can both have duties in an agreement, leaving sense:004 viable.
"Investigators identified corrosion as the principal cause of the failure.": Principal attributively ranks cause. Sense:006 denotes a criminally responsible person, not a ranking modifier of a cause.

"Extra payments can help you pay down the principal faster.": Pay down denotes reducing an outstanding capital amount through payments. Sense:007 is an obligor, which cannot itself be reduced in amount by paying down.

"The fund aims to protect the principal while generating modest returns.": The translation explicitly selects capital, but English protecting a principal while generating returns can mean protecting an agency client as well as preserving capital. No explicit capital-loss or principal-versus-income distinction excludes sense:004.

"A college principal addressed the graduating class.": College principal is an institutional head title. Sense:005 denotes a performer or orchestral section leader, a role not expressed by the college-head compound.
